narrator.name: Frumo Narrator
narrator.description: An original mature storyteller with a clear, warm, weathered voice, restrained theatrical energy, measured pacing, and the gravity of a maritime historical epic. Neutral English pronunciation. Never imitate a real performer.
narrator.previewText: Before revolution had a flag, it had a ledger soaked in seawater. The tide remembers every promise made above it.

lafayette.name: Lafayette of Frumo
lafayette.description: An original principled naval revolutionary in early middle age, composed and humane, with confident projection, crisp diction, restrained passion, and the authority of a captain who values freedom over revenge. Never imitate a real person.
lafayette.previewText: Freedom cannot survive if every disagreement becomes treason. Restore the burden of choice.

polea.name: Lord Commander Polea
polea.description: An original charismatic fleet commander in middle age, resonant and commanding, energetic but controlled, with a heroic public cadence that can harden into imperial certainty. Never imitate a real person.
polea.previewText: Today the republic needs victory. One helm can carry a fleet through any storm.

danton.name: Corsair Danton
danton.description: An original bold revolutionary corsair with a broad, forceful voice, quick confident pacing, contagious courage, and rough humor shaped by cannon smoke and crowded taverns. Never imitate a real person.
danton.previewText: Silver Shoals was built to scare us. Then watch what escapes when common hands break royal stone.

marat.name: Marat of the Reefs
marat.description: An original sharp political agitator with a lean, intense voice, fast incisive delivery, skeptical intelligence, and anger kept just beneath the words. Never imitate a real person.
marat.previewText: Fear must change sides, but purity is only the mask fear wears when it wants a judge's chair.

robespier.name: Robespier the Red Tide
robespier.description: An original austere revolutionary judge with precise diction, cool conviction, controlled intensity, and a severe voice that grows frightening because it rarely rises. Never imitate a real person.
robespier.previewText: No kingdom can be free while the crown still lives. Mercy is how tyrants learn to swim back.

mirabeau.name: Privateer Mirabeau
mirabeau.description: An original eloquent privateer and public speaker with a rich persuasive voice, deliberate rhetorical rhythm, seasoned confidence, and the warmth to turn a tavern into an assembly. Never imitate a real person.
mirabeau.previewText: A king who ignores his people will hear their cannons. Let every whispered complaint become a speech.

ludvik.name: King Ludvik
ludvik.description: An original aging maritime monarch with polished formal diction, entitled weariness, defensive pride, and the brittle authority of a ruler who mistakes ownership for responsibility. Never imitate a real person.
ludvik.previewText: You call it greed. I call it responsibility. Do you know how difficult it is being king?

royal-officer.name: Frumo Royal Officer
royal-officer.description: An original disciplined royal officer with clipped formal delivery, institutional confidence, and a stern mid-range voice trained to make decrees sound inevitable. Never imitate a real person.
royal-officer.previewText: By order of the crown, every hold, net, vault, and table owes tribute.

foreign-admiral.name: Foreign Admiral
foreign-admiral.description: An original rival admiral with a deep, disciplined naval voice, restrained contempt, deliberate pacing, and the calm confidence of someone commanding a fleet beyond the horizon. Never imitate a real person.
foreign-admiral.previewText: You have saved them. That is the dangerous part. Tomorrow they will need permission.

councilor.name: Councilor of Captains
councilor.description: An original older civic councilor with a thoughtful, tired voice, careful diction, moral steadiness, and the courage to challenge a victorious commander without theatrical bravado. Never imitate a real person.
councilor.previewText: You were given command for one crisis. A republic should be slower than a warship.

shadow.name: Polea's Shadow
shadow.description: An original uncanny inner voice closely matched to a heroic commander but quieter, colder, and more intimate, with patient accusation and a subtle hollow resonance. It must remain clearly fictional and must not imitate a real person.
shadow.previewText: Say it plainly. You trust the people only after they obey. History remembers chains too.

coral-envoy.name: Coral Crown Envoy
coral-envoy.description: An original diplomatic sea-prince with refined, firm diction, controlled urgency, and a clear voice trained for negotiation among rival fleets. Never imitate a real person.
coral-envoy.previewText: The seas do not belong to one captain. You win waters faster than you can know them.

brasswater-admiral.name: Brasswater Admiral
brasswater-admiral.description: An original industrial league admiral with a low, metallic-edged voice, economical delivery, tactical patience, and open contempt for imperial spectacle. Never imitate a real person.
brasswater-admiral.previewText: Fear sounds like obedience. That is why the tide will hate you.

ice-leviathan.name: Ice Leviathan
ice-leviathan.description: An original ancient nonhuman leviathan, immense and slow, with a very deep resonant voice, glacial pauses, breath like distant ice, and controlled menace. Intelligible English with restrained supernatural texture. Never imitate a real performer.
ice-leviathan.previewText: This is not tide. This is silence. Command freezes before it reaches me.
